title: Quick Italian Cheese Pasta
description: A sour, gooey, solo-dinner Ligureu-inspired dish made with sweet chilli sauce, binchotan charcoal, and gluten‑free pasta, all cooked in one pan.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a lazy-susan-spinner pan over medium heat.
Add the binchotan charcoal powder and stir for 30 seconds to release aroma.
Toss in the gluten-free penne and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Pour in sweet chilli sauce, rice vinegar, and lemon zest; stir to coat pasta evenly.
Reduce heat to low and add shredded Pecorino and grated Parmesan, stirring until cheese melts into a gooey sauce.
Season with sea salt and cracked black pepper, adjusting to taste.
Continue cooking for 2-3 minutes until pasta is al dente and sauce thickens.
Remove from heat and let rest for 1 minute to allow flavors to settle.
Serve immediately hot in the same pan, garnished with a final sprinkle of cheese.
Enjoy this quick solo-dinner Italian dish while the aroma lingers.
